free_tier.stated: Unmetered Bandwidth: all data centers provide unlimited bandwidth. Shared IPv4: a NAT VPS shares one IPv4 and assigns a different port for each user. [vendor page]

egress.terms: Unmetered bandwidth, stated on the vendor page.; ingress: udp

interface_detail: SSH with root and a web panel with console, reinstall and port request.
tooling: ssh, wg-quick; the panel issues the public port range
chaining: Full root means WG terminates here and a conf is generated locally, so this is an ingress endpoint plus relay in one free box.
binding_note: Unmetered bandwidth means no byte quota exists, so nothing in the volume sense fails at 1 TiB/month. What stops a month-long run is the 7-day instance life: miss one renewal and the machine and its address are gone. The vocabulary has no kind for instance lifetime, so retention-clamped carries it, with the caveat that the vendor discloses the 7 days rather than clamping silently.

identity_cost.detail: Registration plus a Telegram account for the renewal code; the renewal flow sends a code through Telegram and adds an arithmetic captcha.

reliability_note: Third-party write-ups record the provider's NAT VPS being unusable during outages; a missed 7-day renewal deletes the instance and its address.
confidence_note: Unmetered bandwidth and the shared-IPv4 model are on the vendor page today; the port count and 7-day renewal come from third-party write-ups. A probe would settle UDP on the assigned ports.

evidence.proved: unmetered bandwidth at all data centers, shared IPv4 with a port per user
public port request uses iptables to pass data from the public IP to the VPS
a shared-IPv4 port range is issued per VPS

notes: The best volume story in the sweep: unlimited bandwidth, full root, no card. Against it: 7-day manual renewal through a Telegram code, a 8-10 port shared IPv4, and a history of the provider's servers going down. A user's no-hardware premise is satisfied because this is a rented-free VM, not owned iron.

extras.wg_detail: A full root VPS with a dedicated IPv6 and a DNAT port range on a shared IPv4; WireGuard can be installed and a peer conf generated on the box. The vendor panel forwards 'data from public ip address to your vps' by iptables without naming a protocol.
extras.volume_stated: Unmetered bandwidth, stated on the vendor page.
extras.transit_note: The provider's European hosts carry the traffic.
